title: Maria's Path to Medicine
text:
Maria studies at a university in Madrid. She wants to become a doctor, so she studies biology and chemistry every day. Her classes start at eight in the morning and finish at four in the afternoon.

Last summer, Maria worked at a hospital as a volunteer. She helped nurses with patients and learned a lot about medicine. Now she thinks that practical experience is as important as studying.

questions.text: What did Maria do last summer?
options: She worked as a volunteer at a hospital

questions.text: Why does Maria think practical experience is important?
options: It helps her understand her future job
It is required for all students

questions.text: What kind of person is Maria most likely to be?
options: Motivated and focused on her goal

vocabulary.definition: a person who works without being paid
useful in real situations, not only in theory
people who receive medical care from doctors or nurses
the science that studies substances and how they change

paragraph_translations: María estudia en una universidad de Madrid. Quiere ser médica, así que estudia biología y química todos los días. Sus clases empiezan a las ocho de la mañana y terminan a las cuatro de la tarde.

El verano pasado, María trabajó como voluntaria en un hospital. Ayudó a las enfermeras con los pacientes y aprendió mucho sobre medicina. Ahora piensa que la experiencia práctica es tan importante como estudiar.
